overview:
**Fire danger is Low today, held down by cool temps, light winds, and incoming midweek moisture rather than any wind event.**
- Danger stays Low all week, with ERC/BI percentiles easing from the high-40s today into the high-30s by Thursday as 1000-hr fuels edge up slightly.
- Wednesday brings the week's key weather driver: a 70% chance of snow/rain showers and possible thunder, adding moisture before winds turn light out of the north.
- Watchout status: 0 of 7 local thresholds met; no Red Flag Warning is in effect for this area.
- No fire restrictions are currently active in Montrose County or on Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison National Forest lands, which rescinded Stage 1 restrictions in September; San Miguel County's most recent posted status shows Stage 2 restrictions still in place.
- No active wildfires are reported in or near this area; the Rocky Mountain Area remains at Preparedness Level 2, with the only uncontained large fire in the national report burning far away in Wyoming.
